name: Bandit
unlock: Rob or hold up someone within town limits. Rank 6 can't be finished before the Chapter 3 mission "Horse Flesh for Dinner", which opens the horse fence.
reward: Ranks 1, 3, 7 and 10 unlock the reinforced Bandit set (bandolier, holster, off-hand holster, gun belt) for purchase at the Trapper; the other ranks pay Dead Eye XP and cash. The Bandit set is a Stamina set: buying one complete Stamina set adds an extra bar to your Stamina core, buying all three (Bandit, Gambler, Master Hunter) adds a second one.
tips: This tree costs a lot of Honor. Wear a bandana to keep bounties low and pay them off at a post office.
Loading a save resets the progress of ranks 3 and 4, so finish them in one go.

ranks.text: Hold up 5 townsfolk.
ranks.guide: The back alleys of Saint Denis at night work well. In "Urban Pleasures" you can rob three people at the trolley station. If a pickpocket robs you, chase him down and take your money back — it counts and costs no Honor.

ranks.text: Rob any 2 coaches or return any 2 stolen coaches to the Fence.
ranks.guide: Loot the box attached to a coach, or drive a coach to a Fence. Looting the box and then fencing the same coach counts as two. The random encounter with two masked O'Driscolls robbing a stagecoach finishes it in one go.

ranks.text: Rob the cash register in any 4 shops in one day.
ranks.guide: Early route: Valentine doctor → Wallace Station general store → Strawberry general store → Valentine general store (the Valentine law calms down in between). If you can dodge the police, Saint Denis alone works: fence, general store, doctor, tailor. Don't reload a save mid-way.

ranks.text: Rob any 3 coaches or return any 3 stolen coaches to the fence in a day.
ranks.guide: Take a stagecoach from Valentine to Emerald Station, rob its box, sell it to the Emerald Ranch fence, then repeat. Robbing the box and fencing the same coach counts twice. Sean's coach robbery mission counts as two. A lock breaker helps.

ranks.text: Amass $250 bounty in one state.
ranks.guide: Murder carries the biggest bounty: shoot someone in town and fight off the lawmen (each one adds a murder charge). Cleaner: replay "Blessed are the Meek?" without a bandana (bounty $300, cleared after the replay). If you already have $250+ in a state, just enter it.

ranks.text: Steal 5 horses and sell them to the Horse Fence at Clemens Cove.
ranks.guide: Needs "Horse Flesh for Dinner" (Chapter 3) first. Fastest: steal a four-horse stagecoach (Rhodes or Emerald Ranch), drive it to the horse fence and cut the horses free one by one — with your spare horse that's all five. Wild horses you break also count (no Honor loss). You can't sell while someone is attacking you.

ranks.text: Rob $50 worth of cash and valuables from townsfolk and travelers.
ranks.guide: Buy a train ticket, and when the ride cutscene ends rob passengers — first class pays most. Rob a few and jump off before the guards react. A pickpocket you chase down and tie up also counts.

ranks.text: Steal 7 wagons and sell them to the Fence at Emerald Ranch.
ranks.guide: Plenty of wagons pass on the roads around Emerald Ranch, and a four-horse stagecoach often spawns at Emerald Station. Subdue the driver, leave no witnesses and make sure the law isn't searching for you, otherwise the fence won't buy.

ranks.text: Hogtie someone and leave them on the railroad 3 times.
ranks.guide: No train is needed — just drop the person squarely between the rails. One person is enough: after it registers, cut them free, lasso and hogtie them again and drop them back, twice more. Check the challenge screen after each drop.

ranks.text: Complete 5 train robberies without dying or being caught.
ranks.guide: Quiet method: buy a ticket, wait for the ride to end, go into a freight car, steal any item (e.g. a tin of vegetables) and leave unseen. Then buy a ticket back and repeat. Valentine ↔ Emerald Station is the cheapest route.

name: Explorer
unlock: Pick up your first treasure map (Jack Hall Gang, Poisonous Trail, Landmarks of Riches, Le Tresor des Morts or the Elemental Trail).
reward: Ranks 1, 3, 7 and 10 unlock the reinforced Explorer set at the Trapper; the other ranks pay Stamina XP and cash. Explorer is a Dead Eye set: buying one complete Dead Eye set adds an extra bar to your Dead Eye core, buying all three (Explorer, Herbalist, Survivalist) adds a second one.
tips: Ranks 2–10 are all "Find a treasure": both the final treasure of a hunt and every intermediate map in it count.
Counting finds per hunt: Jack Hall Gang 3, Poisonous Trail 3, High Stakes 3, Landmarks of Riches 4, Elemental Trail 3, Le Tresor des Morts 2. Three or four hunts finish the whole tree.
The Torn Treasure Map and the Sketched Map hunts do not count. Arguably the easiest challenge tree.

ranks.text: Find a treasure map.
ranks.guide: Easiest: buy the Jack Hall Gang map from Máximo south-west of Horseshoe Overlook (stranger mission "All That Glitters", Chapter 2) — decline $10 and he drops to $5. Alternative: the Poisonous Trail map in a lockbox under the bed by the door in Cairn Lodge (Cairn Lake, north-west Ambarino).

ranks.text: Find a treasure.
ranks.guide: Jack Hall Gang treasure 1: Caliban's Seat, just north of where you met Máximo. Climb the path from the north side to the small camp at the top, then work your way down to the right.

ranks.text: Find a treasure.
ranks.guide: Jack Hall Gang treasure 2: Cotorra Springs (Ambarino) — at the largest rock at the top; circle it slowly until the prompt appears.

ranks.text: Find a treasure.
ranks.guide: Jack Hall Gang treasure 3: the small island in O'Creagh's Run lake — a loose rock on the south side of the island hides two gold bars.

ranks.text: Find a treasure.
ranks.guide: High Stakes map 1 (after meeting Máximo): a treasure hunter studying a map between Diablo Ridge and Riggs Station — knock him down by running into him (no Honor loss) or buy the map from a Fence later. It leads behind the waterfall at Cumberland Falls, where map 2 is.

ranks.text: Find a treasure.
ranks.guide: High Stakes map 2 → Barrow Lagoon (frozen lake in the Grizzlies West, north-west of Valentine): map 3 is inside the log bridge between the island and the shore.

ranks.text: Find a treasure.
ranks.guide: High Stakes map 3 → the ridge between Fort Wallace and Bacchus Station: drop down from the rock path above the carving on the north-west side; three gold bars under a low overhang.

ranks.text: Find a treasure.
ranks.guide: Poisonous Trail map 1 → map 2 in the base of a hollow tree trunk near Face Rock, Scarlett Meadows (left of the road north-west of Hill Haven Ranch).

ranks.text: Find a treasure.
ranks.guide: Poisonous Trail map 3: Serpent Mound in lower Roanoke Ridge, west of Van Horn — in the middle of the oval rock formation at the western end.

ranks.text: Find a treasure.
ranks.guide: Poisonous Trail treasure: the hidden cave at Elysian Pool — climb the first ledge, go down the hole on the right, crouch through the gap and follow the right wall. Short of a find? Landmarks of Riches (first map west of Owanjila) counts too.

name: Gambler
reward: Ranks 1, 3, 7 and 10 unlock the reinforced Gambler set at the Trapper; the other ranks pay Dead Eye XP and cash. Gambler is a Stamina set: buying one complete Stamina set adds an extra bar to your Stamina core, buying all three (Bandit, Gambler, Master Hunter) adds a second one.
tips: Poker: Flatneck Station (station building), Saint Denis (Bastille Saloon), Valentine (Smithfield's Saloon). Blackjack: Rhodes (Parlour House) and Van Horn (Old Light Saloon). Dominoes: Saint Denis, Emerald Station, camp mornings (7 am – 12 pm).

Five Finger Fillet: Strawberry (by the stagecoach, south-west of town), Valentine (Keane's Saloon, not always), Van Horn (behind the brick building south of the Old Light Saloon). If nobody's at a table, run off for ~10 seconds and come back.
Many of these ranks are luck. Saving and reloading does not preserve streaks.

ranks.text: Win 5 hands of poker.
ranks.guide: Play small until you have a strong hand; going all-in often makes everyone fold. Playing poker during "Who is Not Without Sin" (Chapter 2) helps.

ranks.text: In Blackjack, double down and win the hand 5 times.
ranks.guide: Double down whenever your total is over 10 (10 or 11 are best). Tables in Rhodes and Van Horn.

ranks.text: Win 3 games of Five Finger Fillet.
ranks.guide: You only need to win the first round against the first opponent. Keep a steady rhythm instead of rushing.

ranks.text: Bust one poker player out in each location (Flatneck Station, Saint Denis, Valentine).
ranks.guide: Knock one player out of all their chips at each of the three tables (e.g. win when they're all-in). If you run out of money, leave, walk away for ~5 seconds and come back to a fresh table.

ranks.text: Win 3 rounds of dominoes without drawing any tiles against 2 or fewer opponents.
ranks.guide: This takes patience. Play in Saint Denis or Emerald Station against one or two players; leave after a bad round and rejoin. Play your biggest tiles and doubles first.

ranks.text: Beat the Blackjack dealer in two locations (Rhodes and Van Horn).
ranks.guide: Win once at each table: Rhodes Parlour House (south of town) and the Old Light Saloon in Van Horn.

ranks.text: Beat the Five Finger Fillet player in every location (Strawberry, Valentine, Van Horn).
ranks.guide: Beat each opponent so he leaves the table. Valentine's table at Keane's Saloon isn't always there — come back later if it's empty.

ranks.text: Win three hands of Blackjack with three hits or more.
ranks.guide: Bet the minimum in Rhodes. Sit at a table with one other player so hands go fast; if your start looks bad, leave and rejoin (costs cents). Aces and 2–6 are good starts; split pairs for more chances at five cards.

ranks.text: Win three games of dominoes in a row.
ranks.guide: Full games, not rounds. Easiest: camp in the morning (7 am) — only one opponent. All Fives / All Threes are faster than Draw. Play high tiles and doubles, block your opponent, and if they're about to win, quit before they play so your streak survives.

ranks.text: Win three hands of Poker in a row.
ranks.guide: A split pot counts; standing up resets the count. Going all-in works well. Guaranteed wins: replay "A Fine Night of Debauchery" (2 wins) and then "Who is Not Without Sin" (third win).

name: Herbalist
reward: Ranks 1, 3, 7 and 10 unlock the reinforced Herbalist set at the Trapper; the other ranks pay Health XP and cash. Herbalist is a Dead Eye set: buying one complete Dead Eye set adds an extra bar to your Dead Eye core, buying all three (Explorer, Herbalist, Survivalist) adds a second one.
tips: Upgrade the satchel early: the Ingredients Pouch (perfect Deer, Badger and Squirrel pelts) holds 20 of each plant, Legend of the East holds 99. The default holds only 10.
Collect every Yarrow, Burdock Root and Currant you see along the way — rank 7 needs 30 of each.
Don't over-pick orchids before rank 9 (some species stop spawning until Algernon's Chapter 4 request).
Ranks 1–6 can all be done in Chapter 2 around Horseshoe Overlook, Cumberland Forest and Dewberry Creek.

ranks.text: Pick 6 Yarrow.
ranks.guide: Yarrow grows almost everywhere in the Heartlands, lots right next to Horseshoe Overlook. If your satchel is full, eating the plant also counts.

ranks.text: Pick and eat 4 species of berry.
ranks.guide: Raspberry (common in the Heartlands), Blackberry (lone bush just south of Horseshoe Overlook; Big Valley), Wintergreen Berry (Cumberland Forest), Evergreen Huckleberry (Roanoke Ridge, south of Braithwaite Manor, swamps near Saint Denis). Eat each from the satchel.

ranks.text: Craft 7 items using sage as an ingredient.
ranks.guide: Craft Potent Horse Stimulant (1 Sage + 1 Common Bulrush) seven times; Potent Bitters (1 Sage + 1 Burdock Root) works too, but save Burdock for rank 7. Hummingbird Sage grows in Cumberland Forest, Roanoke Ridge, Scarlett Meadows and West Elizabeth woods. Use or drink tonics if the satchel is full.

ranks.text: Pick 5 mushrooms and feed them to your horse.
ranks.guide: All five can be the same species; mushrooms already in your satchel count. Parasol mushrooms grow on the plain east of Horseshoe Overlook, Chanterelles near Dewberry Creek.

ranks.text: Craft 9 items using Indian Tobacco as an ingredient.
ranks.guide: Craft Potent Snake Oil nine times (1 Indian Tobacco each, no pamphlet). Indian Tobacco grows just west of the railroad near Horseshoe Overlook.

ranks.text: Pick 15 different species of herb.
ranks.guide: Between Dewberry Creek and Eris Field you'll find 14 of them: American Ginseng, Chanterelles, Common Bulrush, Creeping Thyme, Evergreen Huckleberry, Hummingbird Sage, Indian Tobacco, Milkweed, Oregano, Parasol Mushroom, Raspberry, Wild Carrot, Wild Mint, Yarrow.

ranks.text: Craft and use 5 special miracle tonics.
ranks.guide: Needs the Special Miracle Tonic pamphlet (Fence, or on a plateau south-east of Vetter's Echo, south of Hanging Dog Ranch). Each tonic: 6 Yarrow + 6 Burdock Root + 6 Golden Currant/Blackcurrant — 30 of each in total. Burdock grows along the Dakota River's Horseshoe bend; Golden Currant around Emerald Ranch and Roanoke Ridge.

ranks.text: Use oleander to craft 6 poison weapons.
ranks.guide: Oleander Sage grows in Bayou Nwa. Craft Poison Arrows (arrow + Flight Feather + Oleander) or Poison Throwing Knives. The Poison Arrow pamphlet is in a lockbox at the Mysterious Hill Home (or from a Fence); the poison knife pamphlet is under the floor of a shack north of the Saint Denis cemetery.

ranks.text: Pick one of each species of herb.
ranks.guide: All 43 plants. There's no in-game checklist and earlier picks don't count — keep your own list (an interactive plant map helps). Blackcurrant, Wild Feverfew, Desert Sage and Red Sage grow only in New Austin, so in practice this is an Epilogue rank. Prairie Poppy grows in the Great Plains near Blackwater.

ranks.text: Season and cook all 11 types of meat.
ranks.guide: Season with Oregano, Creeping Thyme or Wild Mint (lots of Wild Mint near Limpany). The 11: Exotic Bird, Tender Pork Loin, Plump Bird, Big Game, Prime Beef, Succulent Fish, Game, Flaky Fish, Crustacean (crab), Gristly Mutton, Mature Venison. Low-quality meat (Gritty Fish, Gamey Bird, Stringy, Herptile) can't be seasoned and isn't needed.

name: Horseman
reward: Ranks 1, 3, 7 and 10 unlock the reinforced Horseman set at the Trapper; the other ranks pay Stamina XP and cash. Horseman is a Health set: buying one complete Health set adds an extra bar to your Health core, buying all three (Horseman, Sharpshooter, Weapons Expert) adds a second one.
tips: Timed rides reset if you dismount, fall off or stop for a shootout. Pausing or opening the map doesn't count toward the time; rain doesn't matter.
"Without touching any water" means streams too — use dry bridges only. A donkey doesn't count (a mule does).

ranks.text: Kill 5 rabbits from horseback.
ranks.guide: Ride through the fields around Valentine and shoot rabbits from the saddle with a revolver or the Varmint Rifle; Dead Eye helps.

ranks.text: Jump over 3 obstacles in 15 seconds.
ranks.guide: Jump three fences in a row at Emerald Ranch.

ranks.text: Ride from Valentine to Rhodes in less than five minutes.
ranks.guide: Feed and brush the horse first and keep its stamina up. Follow the road south-east; don't dismount or get into fights on the way.

ranks.text: While mounted, drag a victim for 3300 feet using your lasso.
ranks.guide: The victim must be alive when lassoed (they'll probably die on the way — that's fine). Using people like the Eugenics Supporter or Jeremiah Compson avoids a bounty. Drag along a straight road.

ranks.text: Trample 5 animals while on horseback.
ranks.guide: The animal must die from the trampling. Chickens at Emerald Ranch are easiest (but may be reported); wild turkeys avoid the law. It also happens by itself when riding off-road.

ranks.text: Ride from Strawberry to Saint Denis in less than 9 minutes without touching any water.
ranks.guide: Ride to Riggs Station, turn right onto the railroad and follow the tracks all the way to Saint Denis, taking the right at the only fork.

ranks.text: Kill 7 enemies from horseback without dismounting.
ranks.guide: Circle a gang hideout like Hanging Dog Ranch shooting with a rifle (feed the horse stimulants first). Dynamite thrown from the saddle into the KKK random encounter is very quick.

ranks.text: Kill 9 predators from horseback.
ranks.guide: Alligators are easiest: they stay still unless you get close, so your horse won't panic — use a long scoped rifle. Coyotes, boars, ravens and hawks also count.

ranks.text: Ride from Van Horn to Blackwater in less than 17 minutes without touching any water.
ranks.guide: Shortcut that counts: leave Van Horn south, cut through the woods to the Kamassa bridge, then off-road to the railway crossing south of Old Greenbank Mill, follow the tracks to Bard's Crossing, cross the Dakota, then ride past Lone Mule Stead to the tip of the peninsula facing Blackwater — the game completes the challenge there. Watch for trains on the bridge.

ranks.text: Break every wild horse breed.
ranks.guide: Has an in-game checklist. Needed: American Paint (Fairvale Shanty), American Standardbred and Morgan (Big Valley), Appaloosa (Cattail Pond), Hungarian Halfbred (Flatneck Station), Kentucky Saddler and Tennessee Walker (Heartland oil derrick), Mustang (Cholla Springs), Nokota (Lone Mule Stead). Thoroughbreds, Arabians and the Andalusian aren't required. Little Creek River west of Wallace Station spawns most of them.

name: Master Hunter
reward: Ranks 1, 3, 7 and 10 unlock the reinforced Master Hunter set at the Trapper; the other ranks pay Health XP and cash. Master Hunter is a Stamina set: buying one complete Stamina set adds an extra bar to your Stamina core, buying all three (Bandit, Gambler, Master Hunter) adds a second one. The Legendary Giaguaro Panther only appears once you reach rank 10.
tips: A clean kill means the right weapon and one shot — see each animal's card in this app.
Bait is sold at general stores; Cover Scent Lotion keeps animals from noticing you.

ranks.text: Skin 3 deer.
ranks.guide: Deer come in herds, especially around Van Horn, Annesburg and north of Saint Denis. Handing a whole carcass to Pearson or a Trapper also counts.

ranks.text: Collect 3 perfect quality rabbit pelts.
ranks.guide: Harder than it looks: use the Varmint Rifle, study each rabbit and shoot only 3★ ones in the head. Don't trample them with the horse. A good moment to also get the Legendary Buck (Buck Antler Trinket improves pelts).

ranks.text: Track 10 different animal species using your binoculars.
ranks.guide: Look through the binoculars, study the animal, then hold Track. Flying birds and farm animals (cows, dogs) don't count.

ranks.text: Call an animal and get a clean kill 5 times.
ranks.guide: Aim at the animal, press Call so it raises its head, then a one-shot headshot with the correct weapon (Dead Eye helps). Deer are easiest. Legendary animals always count as clean kills.

ranks.text: Skin 3 black or grizzly bears.
ranks.guide: Black bears north of Strawberry, grizzlies west of Valentine and in the Grizzlies. Quality doesn't matter, and you can drop the pelts afterwards. The Legendary Bharati Grizzly counts.

ranks.text: Kill 5 cougars with your bow, then skin them.
ranks.guide: Cougars: Roanoke Ridge (most spawns during the story), south-west of Blackwater by the water, north-west of Strawberry, around Tumbleweed in the Epilogue. Stand on a big rock or a wagon — the cougar can't reach you — and use Dead Eye with Improved/Poison Arrows.

ranks.text: Use bait to lure and kill both a herbivore and predator.
ranks.guide: Bait doesn't summon animals: find one first, put bait down near it and step back ~20 m. Do the predator first (they're rarer), then a herbivore right after. Coyotes and deer in the Heartlands are ideal.

ranks.text: Catch 3 small fish without using a fishing rod.
ranks.guide: Shoot fish near the shore with a bow or the Varmint Rifle (Dead Eye), or gallop your horse through medium-deep water and pick up the trampled fish. Dynamite destroys small fish. The lagoon at Hani's Bethel is a safe spot.

ranks.text: Kill an opossum playing possum.
ranks.guide: Spook an opossum (north of Annesburg, Flat Iron Lake shores) so it faints, then shoot it while it plays dead.

ranks.text: Find and kill the legendary panther "Giaguaro".
ranks.guide: East of Braithwaite Manor, down by the water. Inspect the three clues — after that it hunts you. Fight from high ground or a wagon, lure it into the open with Predator Bait, use your strongest rifle and headshots.

name: Sharpshooter
reward: Ranks 1, 3, 7 and 10 unlock the reinforced Sharpshooter set at the Trapper; the other ranks pay Dead Eye XP and cash. Sharpshooter is a Health set: buying one complete Health set adds an extra bar to your Health core, buying all three (Horseman, Sharpshooter, Weapons Expert) adds a second one.
tips: Gang hideouts (Hanging Dog Ranch, Shady Belle, Fort Mercer in the Epilogue) give plenty of targets without Honor loss.
Dead Eye level 3 ("Urban Pleasures", Chapter 4) makes ranks 8 and 9 much easier.

ranks.text: Kill 3 flying birds.
ranks.guide: A shotgun on a flock by the water is easiest.

ranks.text: Kill 2 different species of animal in the same Dead Eye use.
ranks.guide: Find mixed wildlife (rabbits and birds in a field, ducks and geese at a lake), activate Dead Eye and shoot two species.

ranks.text: Kill 5 flying birds while on a moving train.
ranks.guide: Stand on the platform at the front of the train: the guards can't reach you there and you get no bounty. They don't have to be five at once. Right after the Billy Midnight photo you're already on a train roof.

ranks.text: Kill someone at 80 feet away with a tomahawk.
ranks.guide: Pick a rival gang camp in open ground (O'Driscolls in the Heartlands, Murfree raids) or Hanging Dog Ranch, and throw from a distance in an upward arc.

ranks.text: Kill 6 animals without switching or reloading your weapon.
ranks.guide: Varmint Rifle in a single Dead Eye on ducks or geese resting by a river (a second Dead Eye reloads the gun), or a revolver on the chickens at Emerald Ranch.

ranks.text: Kill someone at least 660 feet away with a long scoped rifle.
ranks.guide: Rolling Block or Carcano with a long scope (it must have one) and High Velocity ammo. Hanging Dog Ranch from across the creek works without Honor loss; the cliffs behind Valentine church also work.

ranks.text: Get 7 headshots in a row.
ranks.guide: Clear a gang hideout aiming only at heads. Animals work too: slow turtles and alligators in Bluewater Marsh or the bison herd west of Heartland Overflow. Frontal shots seem to register best.

ranks.text: Disarm 3 enemies without reloading or switching your weapon.
ranks.guide: At Hanging Dog Ranch sneak behind a guard and shoot his rifle (reticle white, not red) with a scoped repeater, run off on foot, repeat. Don't mount your horse — that holsters the gun and resets. A Poison Arrow to the leg also makes them drop their weapon, and the bow never reloads.

ranks.text: Shoot 3 people's hats off in the same Dead Eye use.
ranks.guide: The three must survive. Needs Dead Eye level 3 (or "Pouring Forth Oil IV" for manual tagging). Top hats in Saint Denis and Del Lobo sombreros (Epilogue) are big targets. From a distance a shotgun knocks hats off without killing. Save first.

ranks.text: Kill 3 flying birds with 3 consecutive long scoped rifle shots.
ranks.guide: Birds must be in flight and the rifle needs a long scope; a miss resets the count. South of the Heartland Oil Fields many birds fly around. Dead Eye helps, and you can go in and out of the scope.

name: Survivalist
unlock: Catch a Bluegill after the Chapter 2 mission "A Fisher of Men".
reward: Ranks 1, 3, 7 and 10 unlock the reinforced Survivalist set at the Trapper; the other ranks pay Stamina XP and cash. Survivalist is a Dead Eye set: buying one complete Dead Eye set adds an extra bar to your Dead Eye core, buying all three (Explorer, Herbalist, Survivalist) adds a second one.
tips: Fishing lures and bait are sold at general stores and bait & tackle shops.

ranks.text: Catch 3 Bluegill fish.
ranks.guide: Bluegill bite on bread or corn in calm ponds and lakes. If it doesn't activate, catch one at the Legendary Bluegill spot.

ranks.text: Hand 5 animals into camp or trapper.
ranks.guide: Whole carcasses count, pelts don't. Fish are accepted — hand in the Bluegills from rank 1.

ranks.text: Kill 5 animals with a varmint rifle.
ranks.guide: Buy the Varmint Rifle at a gunsmith (or get it from a random encounter south of Lagras) and shoot any small animals.

ranks.text: Craft a dynamite, fire, improved, poison, and small game arrow.
ranks.guide: Fire, Improved and Small Game recipes are known from Chapter 2. Dynamite and Poison arrows need pamphlets (Fence; the Poison one is also in a lockbox at the Mysterious Hill Home).

ranks.text: Catch a fish in the Bayou from a riverboat and while standing on train tracks.
ranks.guide: Either order. A fishing boat waits at the dock north of Hagen Orchards (bayou). Then stand on a railroad bridge over water and catch anything.

ranks.text: Kill a scavenging animal while it is feeding a corpse 5 times.
ranks.guide: Drop a deer carcass in an open field, crouch nearby and kill hawks, crows or ravens with a bow as they land. Animals feeding on bait count too.

ranks.text: Kill 8 small game animals with consecutive shots, using small game arrows.
ranks.guide: A miss, a non-lethal hit, a non-small-game target, another weapon or loading a save resets the count. Easy targets: the chickens at Emerald Ranch, rats in Doyle's Tavern or the cave behind the Elysian Pool waterfall.

ranks.text: Craft a homing tomahawk, improved tomahawk, volatile dynamite, and volatile fire bottle.
ranks.guide: The recipes come from pamphlets sold by Fences. The Homing Tomahawk needs an Owl feather — an owl often sits on top of Emerald Station at night.

ranks.text: Catch a fish that weighs at least 19 lbs.
ranks.guide: Easiest with a heavy legendary fish. Otherwise use a special lure where Lake Sturgeon and Muskie live (Flat Iron Lake, Elysian Pool).

ranks.text: Catch one of each type of fish throughout the world.
ranks.guide: Legendary fish count for their species (e.g. the Legendary Largemouth Bass counts as a Largemouth Bass). Track what you still need in the Compendium.

name: Weapons Expert
unlock: Kill an enemy with your knife.
reward: Ranks 1, 3, 7 and 10 unlock the reinforced Weapons Expert set at the Trapper; the other ranks pay Health XP and cash. Weapons Expert is a Health set: buying one complete Health set adds an extra bar to your Health core, buying all three (Horseman, Sharpshooter, Weapons Expert) adds a second one.
tips: Hogtie several enemies and lay them next to each other — that makes ranks 2, 4, 6 and 7 easy.
Gang hideouts (Hanging Dog Ranch, Shady Belle, Beaver Hollow; Fort Mercer and Gaptooth Ridge in the Epilogue) give many enemies without Honor loss.

ranks.text: Kill 3 enemies with a knife.
ranks.guide: Happens naturally — several story missions require stealth knife kills.

ranks.text: Kill 3 enemies in 10 seconds using only throwing knives.
ranks.guide: Replay "Paying a Social Call" (Chapter 2): three O'Driscolls at the start have their backs to you — Dead Eye, aim for the heads. Animals count too (the chickens at Emerald Ranch).

ranks.text: Kill 3 birds of prey using only a tomahawk.
ranks.guide: Put a deer carcass in an open field and throw at ravens landing on it (don't spook them first). Eagles rest at the end of the dock at Swadbass Point by day; owls sit on lonely shack roofs at night.

ranks.text: Kill 10 enemies with a shotgun using crafted ammo.
ranks.guide: Use incendiary or explosive shells at a gang hideout (Thieves' Landing, Hanging Dog Ranch). Hogtied enemies lying together can go down with one shot.

ranks.text: Kill 5 mounted enemies, using 1 throwing knife per kill.
ranks.guide: Commit a small crime and wait in the wild — bounty hunters usually arrive on horseback. As Arthur, Pinkertons ride around the Great Plains. Dead Eye, aim for the head.

ranks.text: Kill 4 enemies at the same time with a single stick of dynamite.
ranks.guide: Hogtie four members of a rival gang camp, lay them together and throw dynamite in the middle. The KKK random encounter is also quick.

ranks.text: Kill 4 consecutive enemies by throwing and retrieving the same tomahawk.
ranks.guide: Drop or throw away all tomahawks but one. Hogtie a group, stand ~10 ft away and use Dead Eye for one-hit headshots. Plan for five kills — the first one only starts the counter. Killing wolves, bears or cougars resets it.

ranks.text: Kill 15 enemies using a long-barreled sidearm.
ranks.guide: Fit a long barrel on a revolver/pistol at a gunsmith and clear a gang hideout. The LeMat revolver doesn't count.

ranks.text: Kill 9 unaware enemies from behind, using the bow.
ranks.guide: At Hanging Dog Ranch you can take out about five guards before being seen. Or shoot the guard left of Fort Mercer's south gate, ride west until the red dots vanish, come back and repeat. Replaying "Paying a Social Call" or "The King's Son" also works.

ranks.text: Kill a grizzly bear without taking damage, using only throwing knives.
ranks.guide: Use Poison Throwing Knives and keep your distance until the poison drops it. A grizzly lives at Vetter's Echo; in the Cairn Lake random encounter a bear attacks the hunter first, giving you free throws. Grizzlies also spawn between Watson's Cabin and Wallace Station.
